description: Medium priority fixes: Improve search cache key hashing (issue #7), add unicode confusable detection to sanitize_user_input (issue #8), verify React Router v7 + React 18 compatibility (issue #9), and add edge-to-backend contract tests (issue #10).
steps: Issue #7: In apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py search_context(), the cache key already hashes with sha256. Verify the cache_input uses 'query:text:user_tier'. The 'text' component here is the embedding (already compact). This is fine as-is. But to improve, change the cache key to hash only the text component separately if it's large, ensuring the key stays fixed-length even if inputs change. The current implementation already does sha256 on the full string which is fine - just add a comment documenting this design decision.

Issue #8: In apps/backend/app/core/security.py sanitize_user_input(), after NFKC normalization and zero-width stripping, add unicode confusable detection. Import unicodedata and add detection for: (1) mixed-script text that could be homoglyph attacks (e.g., Cyrillic 'a' vs Latin 'a'), (2) additional invisible/formatting characters beyond the existing zero-width set (like U+00AD soft hyphen, U+034F combining grapheme joiner, U+2028 line separator, U+2029 paragraph separator, U+FE00-U+FE0F variation selectors). Strip these additional invisible characters. Do NOT reject mixed-script text outright (users legitimately write in Assamese+English) - just strip the dangerous invisible chars.

Issue #9: In apps/frontend/package.json, react-router-dom ^7.5.1 with react ^18.3.1. React Router v7 officially supports React 18 (confirmed before GA). Add a comment in package.json (or a COMPATIBILITY.md note) documenting this. No version change needed. Verify the frontend test suite passes.

Issue #10: Add contract/integration tests in apps/edge/tests/contract.test.ts that verify the edge-to-backend interface. Mock backend responses and test that edge routing logic correctly: (a) proxies /api/v1/chat POST to backend, (b) passes correct headers (X-User-ID, X-Rate-Limited-By), (c) handles backend 5xx gracefully, (d) validates the expected request/response shapes for chat and auth endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Azure search cache key has a documenting comment about sha256 hashing approach
sanitize_user_input strips additional invisible unicode characters (soft hyphen, variation selectors, etc.)
Frontend tests pass with current React Router v7 + React 18 setup
New edge contract test file exists at apps/edge/tests/contract.test.ts with 4+ test cases
All existing backend tests still pass
Edge tests pass with pnpm test from apps/edge/
verification: Run python -m pytest from apps/backend/ and confirm all tests pass
Run pnpm test from apps/edge/ and confirm all tests pass
Run pnpm test from apps/frontend/ and confirm tests pass
findings: All tests pass: 163 backend, 60 edge (including 6 new contract tests), 620 frontend. React Router v7 + React 18 confirmed compatible with no version changes needed. Unicode confusable stripping added without breaking existing sanitization tests.
